name: User

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the user.
Unique username used for login.
First name of the user.
Last name of the user.
Email address of the user.
Indicates whether the account is active.
Defines the user role: superadmin, admin, technician, or client.
Middle name of the user.
Contact number of the user.

description: Stores the account information of all users in the system, including superadmin, admin, technician, and client accounts.

name: Client Profile

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the client profile.
Foreign key referencing the user.
Type of the client: individual, business, or corporate.
Company name of the client.
Billing address of the client.
Contact method preferred by the client: email or phone.
Current account balance of the client.

description: Stores client-specific details such as client type, company name, billing address, preferred contact method, and account balance. Each profile belongs to exactly one user account.

name: Technician Profile

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the technician profile.
Foreign key referencing the user.
Latest latitude of the technician.
Latest longitude of the technician.
Overall skill level of the technician: beginner, intermediate, or expert.

description: Stores technician-specific details such as the current GPS position and skill level. Each profile belongs to exactly one user account.

name: Management Profile

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the management profile.
Foreign key referencing the user.

description: Stores the management profile of an administrator or superadmin account. Each profile belongs to exactly one user account.

name: User Capability Grant

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the user capability grant.
Foreign key referencing the user.
Code of the capability granted to the user.

description: Records each capability code granted to a user. The system uses these grants, together with the user role, to control which actions a user may perform.

name: Admin Settings

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the admin settings.
Name of the system shown to users.
Email address used for support.
Indicates whether email notifications are turned on.
Daily overtime capacity, in minutes, available for scheduling.
Default time zone of the system.
Time the business day starts.
Time the business day ends.
Foreign key referencing the user who last updated the location validation setting.
Foreign key referencing the user who last updated the record.

description: Stores the system-wide settings managed by administrators, such as the system name, support email, email notification switch, business hours, time zone, and overtime capacity.

name: Landing Page Asset

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the landing page asset.
Original file name of the uploaded asset.
Content type of the uploaded file.
Foreign key referencing the user who uploaded the file.

description: Stores the files uploaded for the public landing page, with their original names and content types.

name: Activity Log

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the activity log.
Foreign key referencing the user who performed the action.
Role of the user at the time the action was performed.
Display name of the user who performed the action.
Category of the logged action: security, users, requests, tickets, inventory, settings, sla, communication, or system.
Action that was performed: login, logout, create, update, delete, assign, reschedule, complete, cancel, error, or system.
Description of what happened.

description: Records the actions performed by users in the system, grouped by category and action, to provide an audit trail.

name: Change Log

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the change log.
Identifier of the type of record that was changed. It refers to the framework content type table, which is outside this diagram.
Type of change: create, update, or delete.
Name of the field that was changed.

description: Records the changes made to the data in the system, including the type of action and the field that was changed.

name: Service Type

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the service type.
Name of the service type.
Category of the service type, such as solar or air conditioning.
Estimated cost of the service type.
Indicates whether the service type can currently be requested.

description: Stores the services offered by the company, with their category, estimated cost, and whether they are currently active.

name: Sla Rule

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the sla rule.
Identifier of the delay that the rule monitors: approval_delay, assignment_delay, start_delay, execution_delay, reschedule_delay, inspection_delay, or service_ready_delay.
Indicates whether the rule is currently enforced.

description: Stores the service-level agreement rules that define the delay checks used to monitor requests and tickets.

name: Service Request

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the service request.
Foreign key referencing the user who is the client.
Foreign key referencing the service type.
Priority of the service request: Low, Normal, High, or Urgent.
Current status of the service request: Pending, Approved, In Progress, Completed, or Cancelled.
Date preferred by the client for the service.
Time slot preferred by the client: morning, midday, afternoon, or evening.
Date and time the request was submitted.

description: Stores the service requests submitted by clients, including the requested service type, priority, status, and preferred date and time slot.

name: Calendar Closure

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the calendar closure.
Date that is closed or limited.
Time slot affected by the closure: all_day, morning, midday, or afternoon.
Availability of the date or time slot: limited or closed.
Reason for closing or limiting the date.
Indicates whether the closure is currently in effect.
Foreign key referencing the user who created the record.
Foreign key referencing the user who last updated the record.
Foreign key referencing the user who reopened the closure.

description: Stores the dates and time slots that administrators have closed or limited for scheduling, with the reason.

name: Service Request Service

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the service request service.
Foreign key referencing the service request.
Foreign key referencing the service type.
Current status of the service within the request: Pending, Approved, In Progress, Completed, or Cancelled.

description: Stores each individual service included in a service request, so that one request can contain several services.

name: Service Location

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the service location.
Foreign key referencing the service request.
Complete address of the service site.
Latitude of the service site.
Longitude of the service site.

description: Stores the address and map coordinates of the site where the requested service will be performed.

name: Solar Estimate

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the solar estimate.
Foreign key referencing the user who is the client.
Foreign key referencing the service request.
Current status of the solar estimate: draft, submitted, reviewed, converted, or expired.

description: Stores the solar estimate prepared for a client and, once converted, the service request it became.

name: Service Ticket

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the service ticket.
Foreign key referencing the service request.
Type of the ticket: inspection or installation.
Foreign key referencing the user who acts as the technician.
Foreign key referencing the user assigned as the administrator.
Date the ticket is scheduled for.
Exact time the ticket is scheduled for.
Time slot the ticket is scheduled for: morning, midday, afternoon, or evening.
Date and time the technician started the job.
Date and time the job ended.
Date and time the ticket was completed.

description: Stores the work tickets created from approved service requests, including the ticket type, assigned technician and administrator, schedule, and start and completion times.

name: Ticket Crew Assignment

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the ticket crew assignment.
Foreign key referencing the service ticket.
Foreign key referencing the user who acts as the technician.

description: Stores the technicians assigned to the crew of a service ticket.

name: Service Status History

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the service status history.
Foreign key referencing the service ticket.
Status that the ticket was changed to.

description: Stores each status that a service ticket has passed through, providing a history of its progress.

name: Ticket Progress

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the ticket progress.
Foreign key referencing the service ticket.
Progress status recorded for the ticket.

description: Stores the progress status recorded for a service ticket while the job is being carried out.

name: Technician Skill

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the technician skill.
Foreign key referencing the user who acts as the technician.
Foreign key referencing the service type.
Skill level of the technician for the service type: beginner, intermediate, or expert.

description: Stores the service types that a technician is able to perform and the skill level for each.

name: Technician Location History

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the technician location history.
Foreign key referencing the user who acts as the technician.
Latitude reported by the technician.
Longitude reported by the technician.

description: Stores the GPS positions reported by technicians over time for location tracking.

name: Arrival Validation Log

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the arrival validation log.
Foreign key referencing the service ticket.
Foreign key referencing the user who acts as the technician.
Action recorded for the technician: navigate, arrival_attempt, arrival_success, arrival_blocked, arrival_bypassed, job_started, or job_completed.
Latitude of the technician when the action was recorded.
Longitude of the technician when the action was recorded.
Latitude of the service site.
Longitude of the service site.

description: Records the navigation, arrival, job start, and job completion actions of a technician, together with the technician and site coordinates used to validate arrival.

name: Inspection Checklist

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the inspection checklist.
Foreign key referencing the service ticket.
Label of the service type that was inspected.
Type of follow-up case requested after the inspection: follow_up, complaint, warranty, revisit, or feedback.
Date the follow-up case is due.

description: Stores the inspection checklist completed by the technician for a ticket, including any follow-up case type and due date.

name: Generated Document

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the generated document.
Foreign key referencing the service ticket.
Type of the generated document: field_service_report, turnover_acceptance, commissioning_checklist, technical_data_sheet, installation_contract, or quotation_proposal.
Title of the generated document.
Current status of the document: draft or finalized.

description: Stores the documents generated for a ticket, such as the field service report, quotation proposal, or installation contract, with their title and status.

name: Technical Data Sheet

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the technical data sheet.
Foreign key referencing the service ticket.
Current status of the technical data sheet: draft, submitted, or reviewed.
Type of the premises, such as residential or commercial.
Category of the premises.
Ownership type of the premises.
Indicates whether the premises are private or government owned.
Type of the rooftop where the system is installed.
Date the client confirmed the technical data sheet.

description: Stores the technical data sheet gathered during the site inspection, describing the premises, ownership, and rooftop type, and the date the client confirmed it.

name: Solar Commissioning Checklist

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the solar commissioning checklist.
Foreign key referencing the service ticket.
Name of the site being commissioned.
Type of the installed inverter.
Serial number of the installed inverter.
Date the system was commissioned.
Current status of the checklist: draft, completed, or finalized.

description: Stores the commissioning checklist of a solar installation, including the site, inverter details, commissioning date, and status.

name: Turnover Acceptance

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the turnover acceptance.
Foreign key referencing the service ticket.
Foreign key referencing the generated document.
Date the installation was turned over to the client.
Name of the client who accepted the turnover.
Date the warranty begins.
Current status of the turnover acceptance: draft, finalized, or accepted.

description: Stores the turnover acceptance signed off by the client after an installation, with the turnover date, the name of the accepting client, and the warranty start date.

name: Quotation Record

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the quotation record.
Foreign key referencing the service ticket.
Foreign key referencing the user who is the client.
Number that identifies the quotation.
Total amount of the quotation.
Down payment amount of the quotation.
Remaining balance of the quotation.
Deposit the client must pay before work can be scheduled.
Current status of the quotation: Draft, Sent, Accepted, or Rejected.

description: Stores the quotation prepared for a ticket, including the quotation number, amounts, required deposit, and status.

name: Installation Contract

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the installation contract.
Foreign key referencing the service ticket.
Date the installation is to start.
Total amount of the contract.
Current status of the contract: draft, finalized, or signed.

description: Stores the installation contract of a ticket, including its start date, total amount, and status.

name: Solar Project Profile

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the solar project profile.
Foreign key referencing the service location.
Foreign key referencing the service ticket from which the project originated.
Total capacity of the solar system.
Number of solar panels installed.
Number of inverters installed.

description: Stores the solar project details of a service location, such as the system capacity and the number of panels and inverters.

name: Field Service Report

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the field service report.
Foreign key referencing the service ticket.
Serial number of the equipment serviced.

description: Stores the field service report of a ticket, including the serial number of the serviced equipment.

name: Installed Equipment

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the installed equipment.
Foreign key referencing the service ticket.
Foreign key referencing the user who is the client.
Type of the installed equipment.
Serial number of the installed equipment.
Capacity or rating of the installed equipment.

description: Stores the equipment installed for a client, with its type, serial number, and capacity, to support warranty and maintenance follow-up.

name: Inventory Category

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the inventory category.
Name of the inventory category.
Foreign key referencing the inventory category that is the parent category.

description: Stores the categories used to group inventory items. A category can belong to a parent category.

name: Inventory Item

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the inventory item.
Name of the inventory item.
Unique stock keeping unit code of the item.
Foreign key referencing the inventory category.
Type of the inventory item: equipment, part, tool, consumable, or other.
Capacity or rating of the item, such as the wattage of a panel.
Number of units currently in stock.
Stock level at or below which a low-stock alert is raised.
Number of units currently reserved for jobs.
Price of one unit of the item.

description: Stores the items kept in inventory, with their SKU, type, capacity, stock on hand, minimum stock, reserved quantity, and unit price.

name: Service Type Inventory Requirement

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the service type inventory requirement.
Foreign key referencing the service type.
Foreign key referencing the inventory item.
Number of units of the item that the service type requires.

description: Stores the inventory items, and how many of each, that a service type requires.

name: Inventory Reservation

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the inventory reservation.
Foreign key referencing the inventory item.
Foreign key referencing the user who acts as the technician.
Number of units reserved.
Date on which the reserved items are needed.
Foreign key referencing the service ticket.
Current status of the reservation: pending, fulfilled, or cancelled.

description: Stores the inventory items reserved for a technician or ticket, with the quantity, required date, and status.

name: Inventory Transaction

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the inventory transaction.
Foreign key referencing the inventory item.
Type of stock movement: purchase, issue, return, transfer, adjustment, reservation, or cancellation.
Number of units moved by the transaction.
Foreign key referencing the user who acts as the technician.
Foreign key referencing the service ticket.
Reference number of the document or ticket related to the transaction.
Date and time the transaction was recorded.

description: Records every stock movement of an inventory item, such as purchase, issue, return, and adjustment, with its quantity and date.

name: Equipment Return Request

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the equipment return request.
Foreign key referencing the service ticket.
Foreign key referencing the user who acts as the technician.
Current status of the equipment return request: pending, verified, or rejected.

description: Stores the requests made by technicians to return unused equipment after a job, with the verification status.

name: Equipment Return Request Item

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the equipment return request item.
Foreign key referencing the equipment return request.
Foreign key referencing the inventory item.
Number of units of the item being returned.

description: Stores each inventory item, and its quantity, included in an equipment return request.

name: Sales Record

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the sales record.
Unique number that identifies the sales record.
Foreign key referencing the service ticket.
Foreign key referencing the user who is the client.
Foreign key referencing the quotation record.
Current status of the sales record: draft, confirmed, or voided.
Date of the sale.
Three-letter code of the currency used.
Total amount agreed with the client.
Reason the sales record was voided, if it was cancelled.
Foreign key referencing the sales record that this record replaces.

description: Stores the sales record of a ticket, including the record number, sale date, currency, agreed total, status, and the record it replaces if it was corrected.

name: Sales Record Line

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the sales record line.
Foreign key referencing the sales record.
Type of the sold line: service, product, equipment, or other.
Foreign key referencing the service type.
Foreign key referencing the inventory item.
Foreign key referencing the installed equipment.
Name of the item or service sold.
Stock keeping unit code of the item sold.
Quantity sold.
Price of one unit.
Total amount of the line.

description: Stores the lines of a sales record, each describing a service, product, or equipment sold with its quantity, unit price, and line total.

name: Sales Payment

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the sales payment.
Foreign key referencing the sales record.
Foreign key referencing the quotation record.
Amount of the payment.
Method used to pay: cash, bank_transfer, gcash, maya, check, card, or other.
Reference number of the payment, such as a transaction or receipt number.
Reason the payment was voided, if it was cancelled.

description: Stores the payments received against a sales record or quotation, with the amount, payment method, reference, and void reason if the payment was cancelled.

name: After Sales Case

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the after sales case.
Foreign key referencing the service ticket.
Foreign key referencing the user who is the client.
Foreign key referencing the user assigned to the case.
Type of the after-sales case: follow_up, maintenance, complaint, warranty, revisit, or feedback.
Current status of the after-sales case: open, in_progress, resolved, or closed.
Priority of the after-sales case: low, normal, high, or urgent.
Date by which the case should be resolved.

description: Stores the after-sales cases opened for a completed ticket, such as follow-ups, maintenance, complaints, and warranty claims, with their priority, status, and due date.

name: After Sales Case Event

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the after sales case event.
Foreign key referencing the after sales case.
Foreign key referencing the user who performed the action.
Type of event recorded for the case: created, status_changed, assigned, reassigned, or updated.
Status of the case before the event.
Status of the case after the event.

description: Stores the history of an after-sales case, recording each creation, assignment, and status change with the user who made it.

name: Maintenance Schedule

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the maintenance schedule.
Foreign key referencing the service ticket.
Foreign key referencing the user who is the client.
Foreign key referencing the service type.
Date the equipment was last serviced.
Date the next maintenance is due.
Date on which the client is reminded of the maintenance.
Current status of the maintenance schedule: scheduled, due_soon, due, completed, or dismissed.
Maintenance risk level calculated for the equipment, such as low, medium, or high.
Numeric maintenance risk score calculated for the equipment.

description: Stores the maintenance schedule of a completed ticket, including the last service date, next due date, reminder date, status, and risk level.

name: Customer Support Case

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the customer support case.
Foreign key referencing the user who is the client.
Foreign key referencing the service ticket.
Unique key that groups the messages belonging to the support case.
Subject of the support case.
Category of the support case: general, billing, schedule, technical, complaint, or warranty.
Priority of the support case: low, normal, high, or urgent.
Current status of the support case: open, in_review, resolved, or closed.

description: Stores the support conversations opened by clients, with their subject, category, priority, and status.

name: Message

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the message.
Foreign key referencing the service ticket.
Foreign key referencing the user who sent the message.
Foreign key referencing the user who received the message.
Type of conversation the message belongs to: direct or group.
Text content of the message.

description: Stores the messages exchanged between users, either directly or in a group, optionally linked to a ticket.

name: Notification

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the notification.
Foreign key referencing the user.
Foreign key referencing the service ticket.
Foreign key referencing the service request.
Full text of the notification.
Short title of the notification.
Type of the notification: ticket_assigned, status_update, reminder, urgent, task_completed, customer_inquiry, message, info, success, warning, or error.
Current status of the notification, such as unread or read.
Indicates whether an email should also be sent for the notification.
Indicates whether the email for the notification was sent.

description: Stores the notifications sent to users, with their title, message, type, status, and whether an email was requested and sent.

name: Service Analytics

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the service analytics.
Date the analytics figures apply to.
Foreign key referencing the service type.
Total number of service requests received.
Average time, in hours, taken to respond to requests.
Average time, in hours, taken to complete requests.
Average client satisfaction score.

description: Stores the daily service analytics, including the number of requests, average response and completion times, and satisfaction score.

name: Technician Performance

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the technician performance.
Foreign key referencing the user who acts as the technician.
Date the performance figures apply to.
Total hours the technician worked.
Average time, in hours, the technician took to respond.
Average time, in hours, the technician took to complete jobs.

description: Stores the daily performance of each technician, including total work hours and average response and completion times.

name: Demand Forecast

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the demand forecast.
Foreign key referencing the service type.
Date the forecast applies to.
Confidence level of the forecast.

description: Stores the forecasted demand for each service type on a given date, with the confidence level of the forecast.

name: Service Trend

rows.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the service trend.
Foreign key referencing the service type.
Type of the trend: seasonal, weekly, monthly, or yearly.

description: Stores the demand trends detected for each service type, such as seasonal, weekly, monthly, or yearly patterns.
